title: confed JSON envelope
description: Every confed command run with --json prints exactly this object on stdout, whether it succeeded or failed. Diagnostics and warnings also go to stderr, so stdout stays parseable. `confed.schema` is bumped only for a breaking change; adding a field to a command's `result` is additive and does not bump it.

version.description: The confed release that produced this output.

command.description: The subcommand that ran, in its canonical spelling.

ok.description: True for exit codes 0 and 10; false for every error.

exit_code.description: The process exit status. See docs/troubleshooting.md.

result.description: The command's payload, described by <command>.schema.json. Null when the command failed.

errors.description: Empty on success. At most one entry today: confed stops at the first fatal error.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes, also printed to stderr as `warning: …`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable name of the exit code.

hint.description: The actionable next step, when confed knows one. Absent otherwise.
